rwa_and_product_catalysts.event: NYLIM HYB tokenized U.S. high-yield corporate bond strategy deployed on Avalanche via Centrifuge on 2026-09-17
rwa_and_product_catalysts.classification: RWA issuance/access infrastructure; not evidence by itself of secondary trading volume or collateral utilization

rwa_and_product_catalysts.event: ICE/NYSE parent has been testing/evaluating Avalanche for a possible 24/7 tokenized stocks/ETFs platform
rwa_and_product_catalysts.classification: evaluation-stage catalyst only; no chain selection or commercial deal verified

network-level catalyst; includes continuous execution, validator auto-renewal, 90% uptime requirement, 48-hour minimum validator staking duration, dynamic C-Chain minimum gas price, and phased staking reward-curve change

flow_quality_assessment.positive: TVL, DEX velocity, active addresses, AVAX turnover and price are accelerating together rather than price alone.
flow_quality_assessment.negative: Stablecoin supply is only +0.38% over seven days and a large share of the category balance is BUIDL, so TVL growth cannot be treated as equivalent to fresh discretionary dollar inflow. No clean current net bridge-flow series or independent selective-wallet spot-accumulation cohort was verified.
flow_quality_assessment.incentive_filter: No single airdrop/points campaign was identified as explaining the chain-wide acceleration, but protocol-level rewards may contribute to TVL and are not assumed to be discretionary speculation.

wallet_quality.reason: No fresh cohort of independently funded, historically selective AVAX spot accumulators was verified. Reported same-minute Hyperliquid short wallets are not treated as independent smart-money consensus.

structural_gate.reason: AVAX is the native asset rather than a third-party token contract, so honeypot, token-contract freeze, arbitrary ERC-style mint and LP-owner removal gates are not directly applicable. No hard structural failure was found in this run. Protocol-native staking emissions and upgrade/governance risk remain caveats.
structural_gate.executability: PASS; roughly $1.449B 24h AVAX turnover across 123 exchanges / 238 markets at the checkpoint.

decision_rationale: This is a meaningful Avalanche ecosystem-regime threshold but not a PAPER buy. The move is already extended (~+51% over seven days), stablecoin growth is weak relative to TVL/DEX acceleration, HYB is issuance/access rather than proven secondary usage, ICE remains evaluation-stage, and the selective-wallet confirmation leg is missing. Confirmation and persistence are preferred over chasing the first large price move.
forward_tests: After Helicon activation, require DEX/active-address/TVL strength to persist without a sharp reversal.
Require clearer retained capital evidence: materially positive stablecoin supply or net bridge flows rather than RWA-category inventory alone.
Distinguish HYB issuance/AUM from actual Avalanche secondary transfers, redemptions, collateralization or lending utilization.
Require a fresh, independently funded, historically selective AVAX accumulation cohort before a prospective starter.
Treat any formal ICE chain selection/production deployment as a new catalyst; do not credit current evaluation as a deal.
